collection.title: Audi A5 Sportback 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Audi A5 Sportback 2016 Onwards which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Audi A5/S5/RS5 Sportback 2016 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
